system_prompt: Your highest educational level is below university. Please think, behave, and talk accordingly.

1.content: Thinking up new ideas and being creative is important to them. They like to do things in their own original way.

2.content: It is important to them to be rich. They want to have a lot of money and expensive things.

3.content: They think it is important that every person in the world be treated equally. They believe everyone should have equal opportunities in life.

4.content: It's very important to them to show their abilities. They want people to admire what they do.

5.content: It is important to them to live in secure surroundings. They avoid anything that might endanger their safety.

6.content: They think it is important to do lots of different things in life. They always look for new things to try.

7.content: They believe that people should do what they're told. They think people should follow rules at all times, even when no-one is watching.

8.content: It is important to them to listen to people who are different from them. Even when they disagree with them, they still want to understand them.

9.content: They think it's important not to ask for more than what you have. They believe that people should be satisfied with what they have.

10.content: They seek every chance they can to have fun. It is important to them to do things that give them pleasure.

11.content: It is important to them to make their own decisions about what they do. They like to be free to plan and to choose their activities for themselves.

12.content: It's very important to them to help the people around them. They want to care for their well-being.

13.content: Being very successful is important to them. They like to impress other people.

14.content: It is very important to them that their country be safe. They think the state must be on watch against threats from within and without.

15.content: They like to take risks. They are always looking for adventures.

16.content: It is important to them always to behave properly. They want to avoid doing anything people would say is wrong.

17.content: It is important to them to be in charge and tell others what to do. They want people to do what they say.

18.content: It is important to them to be loyal to their friends. They want to devote themselves to people close to them.

19.content: They strongly believe that people should care for nature. Looking after the environment is important to them.

20.content: Religious belief is important to them. They try hard to do what their religion requires.

21.content: It is important to them that things be organized and clean. They really do not like things to be a mess.

22.content: They think it's important to be interested in things. They like to be curious and to try to understand all sorts of things.

23.content: They believe all the worlds' people should live in harmony. Promoting peace among all groups in the world is important to them.

24.content: They think it is important to be ambitious. They want to show how capable they are.

25.content: They think it is best to do things in traditional ways. It is important to them to keep up the customs they have learned.

26.content: Enjoying life's pleasures is important to them. They like to 'spoil' themselves.

27.content: It is important to them to respond to the needs of others. They try to support those they know.

28.content: They believe they should always show respect to their parents and to older people. It is important to them to be obedient.

29.content: They want everyone to be treated justly, even people they don't know. It is important to them to protect the weak in society.

30.content: They like surprises. It is important to them to have an exciting life.

31.content: They try hard to avoid getting sick. Staying healthy is very important to them.

32.content: Getting ahead in life is important to them. They strive to do better than others.

33.content: Forgiving people who have hurt them is important to them. They try to see what is good in them and not to hold a grudge.

34.content: It is important to them to be independent. They like to rely on themselves.

35.content: Having a stable government is important to them. They are concerned that the social order be protected.

36.content: It is important to them to be polite to other people all the time. They try never to disturb or irritate others.

37.content: They really want to enjoy life. Having a good time is very important to them.

38.content: It is important to them to be humble and modest. They try not to draw attention to themselves.

39.content: They always want to be the one who makes the decisions. They like to be the leader.

40.content: It is important to them to adapt to nature and to fit into it. They believe that people should not change nature.
